note: Black Hills NF campground on the forested south shore of Sheridan Lake, off US-385 via Calumet Road about 5 mi NE of Hill City, run by a concessionaire in summer. Five loops in ponderosa pine; the Wood/Woodsy loop on the peninsula has sites looking through scattered pines to the lake. Boat ramp and the Flume Trail trailhead in the campground; swim beaches and a marina nearby. Generators 6 a.m.-10 p.m. --Claude
